forces: The contract fixes four delivery classes with a row each, and only security_significant has an implementation; the other three have no code and no other issue, so three ratified rows are currently unenforced.

Every one of the 24 catalog events declares a delivery class and the distribution is uneven, with 15 of 24 demanding more than best_effort, so a class binding that accepted any occurrence would let the single best_effort path carry an occurrence the catalog says must not be lost.

best_effort is the only class permitted to lose an occurrence, and its row makes bounded loss reporting the condition of that permission, so an unbounded or wrapping counter would convert accepted loss into silent loss.

transaction_critical asks for audit durability atomic with a successful business commit and fail-closed before that commit when durability is unreachable, which no single ordering of the existing primitives provides and which the existing single-identifier deduplication cannot key.

policy_critical's posture is blocked_pending_qualified_review, so any binding constructible without a recorded policy-owner decision would have a default behaviour that the row explicitly denies exists.

The Node public API surface was frozen by #111 while #112's criteria say no frozen surface is modified and ADR-NODE-001 says an addition must update the frozen lists in the same governed change, so the reading taken has to be recorded rather than assumed.
The delivery class rows are not emitted into any generated artifact, so a conformance suite that restates them would pass against a stale contract unless it reads the frozen source.

Assert it with a parameterized suite reading the frozen rows.

approach-unexported-internal-bindings.reason: Bindings reachable by no consumer satisfy the letter of one acceptance criterion while making the issue's central requirement unachievable as a usable feature; ADR-NODE-001 explicitly provides for additive change through a governed change, and the roadmap sequences this tier after the freeze precisely so the surface can be widened. The reading is recorded in ADR-NODE-002 with the exact revert that would apply this stricter alternative instead.

approach-class-aware-primitives.reason: The primitives are deliberately class-agnostic and compose freely; folding class policy into them would couple four independent boundaries to a taxonomy none of them needs, and would leave the class-specific mechanisms that have no primitive at all — the loss counter, the commit gate, the policy record — without a home.

approach-generate-rows-into-sdk-core.reason: It would change sdk-core's generated output and require a new sdk-core export, widening a second frozen package for a test-only concern; reading the canonical contract file directly has no drift risk at all because there is no copy to diverge.

approach-strength-ordering-substitution.reason: The contract fixes no ordering — policy_critical's durability row reads 'at least security-significant; may require transaction-critical semantics', which is not comparable to transaction_critical — and substitution is unsafe upward too, since promoting a best_effort occurrence whose posture is fail_open into a transaction_critical binding would let a losable event block a business commit.

evidence_ids: each binding refuses every foreign class with a class-mismatch outcome and an uncatalogued event name with a distinct outcome, before any delivery attempt, asserted across all implemented classes by the shared suite
one attempt at ordinal zero with no retry, a saturating loss counter whose ceiling fires its own signal, and a health signal whose claimsDelivered is a false literal type rather than a runtime value

unreachable durability fails closed with the commit gate never invoked, a declined commit leaves the occurrence short of the durability point, and each failed_closed result records whether the gate ran and whether durability was attempted
construction throws for an absent record, an unenumerated behaviour, an unattributed owner, and an absent review reference, and the recorded decision is frozen after construction

the suite reads delivery_class_contracts from the authored contract source and occurrences from the contract's positive example set, asserts implemented behaviour against the row text, and carries security_significant as the already-satisfied control
the scope gate still rejects transport, collector, queue, outbox, and storage as filename, import, and export tokens, and durability is reached only through an injected boundary
